bound: one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the probe automatic-fill error rate
why_these_minimums: With zero errors, 59 fills is the smallest n whose 95% upper bound is at most 0.05, and 29 is the smallest whose bound is at most 0.10. A smaller n cannot clear the budget. Zero observed errors on fewer fills does not enable autofill.
two_percent_not_established: A 2% upper bound would need at least 149 zero-error automatic fills. This gate is not that budget, and the visual-gold-1 result of 112 fills is not this benchmark.
if_not_met: ocrAutofill stays false. The page keeps the value as review. Reliability is not established.
probe: Calibration scores the hard gates with every type forced on. That probe is not what the page ships. The page ships ocrAutofill from FROZEN-e2e.json.
